name: Turkey Meatballs with Tomato Sauce, Penne & Roast Broccoli (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat oven to 450°F. Place oven racks in the upper and middle positions.

Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crown broccoli
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until broccoli is golden brown and tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems. Mince the leaves and place in a medium bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl with the basil. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)

Add turkey, bread crumbs, egg, and spices to the bowl with the basil and Parmesan; use your hands to combine the turkey mixture. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb ground turkey
⅔ cup panko bread crumbs
1 egg
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through).
Once the water is boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside.
Meanwhile, place tomato sauce and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (8 fl oz) can tomato sauce
1 tsp Italian seasoning
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are browned, add tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to coat. Place skillet on the middle rack of the oven and bake until meatballs are cooked through and sauce is warm, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the meatballs are baking, drain and roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and olives.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
⅛ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are done, remove 6 to 8 meatballs and a ½-cup sauce, for the kids plates. Add sun-dried tomatoes, artichokes, olives, and crushed red pepper to the skillet with the remaining meatballs and sauce, then stir to combine.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of pasta, reserved meatballs, sauce, and 1 cup of roasted broccoli between plates. Drizzle pasta with oil and top meatballs with a small handful of the reserved Parmesan. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining pasta, meatballs, sauce, and roasted broccoli between plates. Sprinkle meatballs with remaining Parmesan and enjoy!
